title: VITAL - Virginia Tech Accelerated Holographic LIFU for Anxiety
official: VITAL - Virginia Tech Accelerated Holographic LIFU for Anxiety
summary: Testing repeated applications of low-intensity focused ultrasound (LIFU) on anxiety symptoms and outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) symptoms; defined by a GAD-7 score \>= 10, OASIS score \>= 8, or a PSWQ score \>= 45.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Claustrophobia
* Contraindications to MRI (certain implants or metal in the body)
* Contraindications to CT (pregnancy)
* Active medical disorder with CNS effects (e.g. Alzheimer's)
* History of neurological disorder
* History of head injury
* Active alcohol or drug dependence
sponsor: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

sites.f: Fralin Biomedical Research Institute at VTC
